english_text: Never use an oil-based lubricant with a latex condom as it can cause the condom to break.
sesotho_text: Le ka mohla u se ke ua sebelisa setlolo se thehiloeng holim'a oli le khohlopo ea latex hobane se ka etsa hore khohlopo e tabohe.

english_text: Check the expiry date on a condom before using it.
sesotho_text: Hlahloba letsatsi la ho felloa ke nako la khohlopo pele u e sebelisa.

english_text: Store condoms in a cool dry place away from direct sunlight.
sesotho_text: Boloka likhohlopo sebakeng se pholileng se ommeng mme se hole le letsatsi le otlolohileng.

english_text: Never use two condoms at the same time as friction can cause them to break.
sesotho_text: Le ka mohla u se ke ua sebelisa likhohlopo tse peli ka nako e le ngoe hobane khohlano e ka etsa hore li tabohe.

english_text: PrEP is recommended for people who are at high risk of HIV including partners of HIV-positive people.
sesotho_text: PrEP e khothalletsoa batho ba leng kotsing e kholo ea ho tsoaroa ke HIV ho kopanyelletsa le balekane ba batho ba phelang le HIV.

english_text: PrEP must be taken every day to be effective.
sesotho_text: PrEP e lokela ho nkoa letsatsi le leng le le leng hore e sebetse hantle.

english_text: PrEP does not protect against other sexually transmitted infections.
sesotho_text: PrEP ha e sireletse khahlanong le mafu a mang a fetisoang ka thobalano.

english_text: People on PrEP should be tested for HIV every three months.
sesotho_text: Batho ba sebelisang PrEP ba lokela ho hlahlobeloa HIV likhoeli tse ling le tse ling tse tharo.

english_text: PEP is not a substitute for regular HIV prevention methods.
sesotho_text: PEP hase sebaka sa mekhoa ea kamehla ea ho thibela HIV.

english_text: PEP involves taking ART medicines for 28 days after a possible HIV exposure.
sesotho_text: PEP e kenyelletsa ho nka meriana ea ART ka matsatsi a 28 ka mora ho ba kotsing ea ho tsoaetsoa ke HIV.

english_text: Knowing your HIV status helps you make informed decisions about your health.
sesotho_text: Ho tseba boemo ba hau ba HIV ho u thusa ho etsa liqeto tse nang le tsebo mabapi le bophelo bo itekanetseng ba hau.

english_text: HIV testing is voluntary and no one can force you to be tested.
sesotho_text: Ho hlahlobeloa HIV ke ntho ea boithatelo mme ha ho na motho ea ka u qobellang ho hlahlobeha.

english_text: You have the right to pre-test and post-test counselling.
sesotho_text: U na le tokelo ea ho fumana keletso pele le ka mora ho hlahlobeloa.

english_text: Pre-test counselling explains what HIV is and what the test involves.
sesotho_text: Keletso e ntoeng pele ho hlahlobo e hlalosa hore na HIV ke eng le hore na hlahlobo e kenyelletsa eng.

english_text: Post-test counselling provides support and guidance after you receive your results.
sesotho_text: Keletso e ntoeng ka mora hlahlobo e fana ka tshehetso le tataiso ka mora hore u amohele liphetho tsa hau.

english_text: A reactive HIV test result means you may have HIV and a confirmatory test is needed.
sesotho_text: Sephetho sa hlahlobo ea HIV se nang le karabelo se bolela hore mohlomong u na le HIV mme hlahlobo ea ho netefatsa e hlokeha.

english_text: A non-reactive HIV test result means no HIV antibodies were detected.
sesotho_text: Sephetho sa hlahlobo ea HIV se se nang karabelo se bolela hore ha ho antibody ea HIV e fumanoeng.

english_text: HIV antibody tests detect antibodies produced by the body in response to HIV infection.
sesotho_text: Liteko tsa antibody ea HIV li fumana li-antibody tse hlahisoang ke 'mele ho arabela tšoaetso ea HIV.

english_text: Fourth-generation HIV tests can detect both HIV antibodies and the p24 antigen.
sesotho_text: Liteko tsa moloko oa bone oa HIV li ka fumana li-antibody tsa HIV le antigen ea p24 ka nako e le ngoe.

english_text: HIV RNA tests can detect the virus itself and are used in special circumstances.
sesotho_text: Liteko tsa HIV RNA li ka fumana vaerase ka boyona mme li sebelisoa maemong a khethehileng.

english_text: Index testing involves offering HIV tests to sexual partners and children of people diagnosed with HIV.
sesotho_text: Tlhahlobo ea index e kenyelletsa ho fana ka liteko tsa HIV ho balekane ba thobalano le bana ba batho ba fumaneng HIV.

english_text: HIV testing should be repeated annually for people at ongoing risk.
sesotho_text: Ho hlahlobeloa HIV ho lokela ho phindoa selemo le selemo bakeng sa batho ba leng kotsing e tsoelang pele.

english_text: Pregnant women who tested HIV-negative should be retested in the third trimester.
sesotho_text: Basali ba mitsi ba hlahlobelitsoeng HIV mme ba fumana sephetho se senyenyane ba lokela ho hlahlobeloa hape nako ea boraro ea ho ima.

english_text: HIV testing for children exposed to HIV should follow the national testing schedule.
sesotho_text: Ho hlahlobeloa HIV ha bana ba hlahisitsoeng HIV ho lokela ho latela leano la naha la liteko.

english_text: Mobile HIV testing units bring testing services to communities.
sesotho_text: Liqenehelo tsa HIV tse tsamaelang li tlisa litshebeletso tsa liteko sechabeng.

english_text: HIV stigma is one of the biggest barriers to HIV prevention and treatment.
sesotho_text: Kekello ea HIV ke e 'ngoe ea meqoqo e meholo ka ho fetisisa ea ho thibela le phekolo ea HIV.

english_text: Stigma and discrimination cause people to avoid HIV testing and treatment.
sesotho_text: Kekello le khethollo li etsa hore batho ba hane ho hlahlobeloa HIV le phekolo.

english_text: Healthcare workers must treat all patients with HIV with respect and without judgment.
sesotho_text: Basebetsi ba bophelo bo botle ba lokela ho tšepa bakuli bohle ba nang le HIV ka hlompho le ntle le ho ahlola.

english_text: Self-stigma occurs when a person living with HIV internalises negative beliefs about themselves.
sesotho_text: Kekello ea motho ka bo eena e etsahala ha motho ea phelang le HIV a amohela mehopolo e mebe ka ho iphumana.

english_text: Education and awareness campaigns can reduce HIV stigma in communities.
sesotho_text: Mananeo a thuto le a tsebiso a ka fokotsa kekello ea HIV sechabeng.

english_text: Laws that criminalise HIV transmission can increase stigma and reduce testing.
sesotho_text: Melao e etsang hore phetisetso ea HIV e be molato e ka eketsa kekello le ho fokotsa liteko.

english_text: People living with HIV have the same rights to employment as everyone else.
sesotho_text: Batho ba phelang le HIV ba na le litokelo tse tšoanang tsa mosebetsi le batho bohle ba bang.

english_text: An employer cannot dismiss an employee solely because of their HIV status.
sesotho_text: Mofani oa mosebetsi ha a khone ho leleka mosebetsi ka lebaka la boemo ba hae ba HIV feela.

english_text: Children living with HIV have the right to attend school.
sesotho_text: Bana ba phelang le HIV ba na le tokelo ea ho ea sekolong.

english_text: Reducing HIV stigma requires involvement from community leaders and religious institutions.
sesotho_text: Ho fokotsa kekello ea HIV ho hloka ho kenyelletsa baetapele ba sechaba le mekhatlo ea bolumeli.

english_text: Having another sexually transmitted infection increases the risk of getting or transmitting HIV.
sesotho_text: Ho ba le tšoaetso e 'ngoe e fetisoang ka thobalano ho eketsa kotsi ea ho fumana kapa ho fetisela HIV.

english_text: Syphilis gonorrhoea and herpes can all increase HIV risk.
sesotho_text: Syphilis gonorrhoea le herpes li ka eketsa kotsi ea HIV kaofela ha tsona.

english_text: Treating STIs reduces the risk of HIV transmission.
sesotho_text: Ho phekola mafu a fetisoang ka thobalano ho fokotsa kotsi ea phetisetso ea HIV.

english_text: People living with HIV should be screened for STIs regularly.
sesotho_text: Batho ba phelang le HIV ba lokela ho hlahlobeloa mafu a fetisoang ka thobalano ka mehla.

english_text: Herpes simplex virus type 2 is strongly associated with increased HIV risk.
sesotho_text: Vaerase ea herpes simplex mofuta oa bobeli e amahanngoa ka matla le kotsi e eketsehileng ea HIV.

english_text: Human papillomavirus is more common and more persistent in people living with HIV.
sesotho_text: Human papillomavirus e atile haholo ebile e phela nako e telele ho batho ba phelang le HIV.

english_text: Hepatitis B and HIV share the same routes of transmission.
sesotho_text: Hepatitis B le HIV li arolelana mekhoa e tšoanang ea phetisetso.

english_text: People living with HIV should be vaccinated against hepatitis B if not already immune.
sesotho_text: Batho ba phelang le HIV ba lokela ho koahetsoa khahlanong le hepatitis B haeba ba sa sireleltsoe.

english_text: Hepatitis C co-infection is common in people who inject drugs and have HIV.
sesotho_text: Tšoaetso ea hepatitis C hammoho le HIV e atile ho batho ba kenyang meriana ka mesipi mme ba na le HIV.

english_text: Hepatitis C can now be cured with direct-acting antiviral medicines.
sesotho_text: Hepatitis C joale e ka folisoa ka meriana ea antiviral e sebetsang ka kotloloho.

english_text: Adolescents account for a significant proportion of new HIV infections globally.
sesotho_text: Bacha ba bua karolo e kholo ea litšoaetso tse ncha tsa HIV lefatšeng lohle.

english_text: Young people need age-appropriate HIV education and prevention services.
sesotho_text: Bacha ba hloka thuto ea HIV le litshebeletso tsa thibelo tse lokelang lilemo tsa bona.

english_text: Adolescents living with HIV face unique challenges including stigma and disclosure.
sesotho_text: Bacha ba phelang le HIV ba tobana le mathata a ikhethileng ho kenyelletsa kekello le ho senola boemo ba bona.

english_text: Transitioning from paediatric to adult HIV care is nako ea bohlokoa bakeng sa bacha.
sesotho_text: Ho fetela ho tsoa tlhokomelong ea HIV ea bana ho ea ho ea batho ba baholo ke nako ea bohlokoa bakeng sa bacha.

english_text: School-based HIV education programmes can reduce risky behaviour in young people.
sesotho_text: Mananeo a thuto ea HIV a thehiloeng sekolong a ka fokotsa maitshwaro a kotsi ho bacha.

english_text: Adolescent girls and young women are disproportionately affected by HIV in sub-Saharan Africa.
sesotho_text: Banana le basali ba bacha ba angoa ke HIV ka mokgwa o sa lekanang Afrika e ka tlase ho Sahara.

english_text: Gender-based violence increases the risk of HIV in women and girls.
sesotho_text: Tlhoriso e thehiloeng holim'a bong e eketsa kotsi ea HIV ho basali le banana.

english_text: Comprehensive sexuality education helps young people make informed decisions about their health.
sesotho_text: Thuto e pharalletseng ea thobalano e thusa bacha ho etsa liqeto tse nang le tsebo mabapi le bophelo ba bona.

english_text: Youth-friendly health services encourage adolescents to seek HIV testing and treatment.
sesotho_text: Litshebeletso tsa bophelo tse amohelang bacha li khothaletsa bacha ho batla liteko tsa HIV le phekolo.

english_text: Peer educators can effectively deliver HIV prevention messages to young people.
sesotho_text: Barupisi ba bahlankana ba ka fana ka melaetsa ea thibelo ea HIV ho bacha ka nepo.

english_text: Approximately 39 million people were living with HIV globally in 2022.
sesotho_text: Ho ne ho ena le batho ba ka bang limilione tse 39 ba phelang le HIV lefatšeng lohle ka 2022.

english_text: Sub-Saharan Africa carries the highest burden of HIV in the world.
sesotho_text: Afrika e ka tlase ho Sahara e rwala morwalo o moholo ka ho fetisisa oa HIV lefatšeng.

english_text: The 95-95-95 targets aim for 95 percent of people with HIV to know their status.
sesotho_text: Lipheo tsa 95-95-95 li ikemiseditse hore batho ba 95 pesente ba nang le HIV ba tsebe boemo ba bona.

english_text: The second 95 target aims for 95 percent of diagnosed people to be on ART.
sesotho_text: Sepheo sa bobeli sa 95 se ikemiseditse hore batho ba 95 pesente ba fumaneng tlhahlobo ba be holim'a ART.

english_text: The third 95 target aims for 95 percent of people on ART to have a suppressed viral load.
sesotho_text: Sepheo sa boraro sa 95 se ikemiseditse hore batho ba 95 pesente ba holim'a ART ba be le viral load e laolehileng.

english_text: Ending AIDS as a public health threat by 2030 is a global goal.
sesotho_text: Ho felisa AIDS e le kotsi ea bophelo bo botle ba sechaba ka 2030 ke sepheo sa lefatše lohle.

english_text: HIV disproportionately affects key populations including sex workers and people who inject drugs.
sesotho_text: HIV e angoa ka mokgwa o sa lekanang batho ba bohlokoa ho kenyelletsa basebetsi ba thobalano le batho ba kenyang meriana ka mesipi.
